descriptor.label: City of Arlington Tax Parcel
descriptor.attribution: City of Arlington, Texas GIS / OpenData

evidence: Frozen city packet and service review confirm the City of Arlington municipal Tax Parcel polygon layer; the official city Plat Search workflow uses its Tax Parcel identify layer for land parcels and recorded plats.

First-party layer metadata defines Tax Parcel as distinct measured tracts of land; the OD_Property service describes land in the city, and its document scope identifies City of Arlington TX. See evidence/source-inspection.json.
Frozen bounded sample contains native TaxParcelId values 4201521, 4201522, 4201523; the exact city point miss is not citywide absence.
